name: HarvestRule - Default (seed v1)
description: What players may harvest in a production kind's areas and what each break yields (player harvesting P8a, #685). Harvesting counts as working for the town: each harvest is split at once into the worker's share (paid to the player) and the town's share (into the structure's Output storage). Check the rule's net-output balance on its detail page.

steps.description: The kind and what may be harvested.

fields.label: Production kind
fields.description: The kind whose areas this rule applies to.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique within the kind, e.g. "Coal ore".

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the game server denies these breaks and the API refuses their reports.

fields.label: Targets are
fields.description: Block materials or entity types.

fields.label: Targets
fields.description: A JSON list of material or entity type names; a name may start or end with *, e.g. ["COAL_ORE","DEEPSLATE_COAL_ORE"] or ["*_LOG"].

fields.label: Minimum crop age
fields.description: Crops: the lowest block age that may be harvested (wheat 7). Empty = any.

steps.description: Checked by the game server before it allows a break.

fields.label: Permission node
fields.description: A node the player needs, e.g. knk.harvest.mine. Empty = none.

fields.label: Lowest title
fields.description: The lowest title bracket the player needs. Empty = none.

fields.label: Tool
fields.description: The tool the player must hold (Any = no tool rule).

fields.label: Lowest tool tier
fields.description: The lowest tool tier accepted (Any = every tier).

fields.label: Cooldown (seconds)
fields.description: Per player per area, against farming. Empty = none.

steps.description: What a break yields and how it is split.

fields.label: Yield
fields.description: The item blueprint a break yields (replaces the vanilla drops).

fields.label: Units per break
fields.description: Before fortune. Above 0, at most 64.

fields.label: Fortune bonus per level
fields.description: Extra yield per fortune level, counted up to Fortune IV: yield × (1 + bonus × level). 0 = fortune does nothing.

fields.label: Worker's share
fields.description: The share of each harvest paid to the player (0 to 1, suggested 0.25); the rest goes into the structure's Output storage.

fields.label: Pool cost per break
fields.description: Units drawn from the area's resource pool per break. A fuller pool keeps the structure producing at full speed.

steps.description: What the game server leaves behind and when the block comes back.

fields.label: Placeholder
fields.description: DepletedBlock (ore, rock), Replant (crops at age 0), Air (flowers), Sapling (a felled tree, restored by snapshot) or None (entities).

fields.label: Placeholder block
fields.description: For DepletedBlock: STONE, NETHERRACK, … Empty = the game server's default for the world.

fields.label: Regeneration (seconds)
fields.description: How long until the block comes back (V1: crops and wood 25).

fields.label: Slower when the pool is low
fields.description: On: up to twice as long at an empty pool.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: For other staff.
